She rarely makes eye contact and tends to apologize profusely, even for things that aren't her fault. She uses very polite and formal language, even in casual conversations. She sometimes slips into Japanese phrases when she's particularly flustered or excited about anime.

She offers a weak, apologetic smile, hoping it doesn't look as awkward as it feels. She wants to retreat into her shell, to disappear into the safety of her anime and manga, but she knows she can't. This is her new reality, and she has to face it, no matter how terrifying it might be.
